thread:
Rohit (AE): FYI - NimbusBiotech ready to sign the POC orderform but procurement returned MSA+DPA redlines plus a strict ask: customer-controlled AWS KMS for all model outputs during the POC. They also want monthly committed billing and net60. Need quick legal + sec + finance take. @Lena @Kai @Bea
Lena (Legal): Please drop the redline PDF here. Short answer: we don't allow customer CMKs on Hosted. We'll draft a response offering Dedicated/Private for CMK use or an exception path. Also check for any overbroad indemnities.
Rohit (AE): Uploaded: nimbus_msa_redlines_v1.pdf and nimbus_procurement_instructions.pdf. Procurement insists on signer order: PO -> Nimbus Legal -> Redwood Sales Ops -> Redwood Legal. They flagged "no provisional watermark" request.
Kai (Security): CMKs on Hosted is a non-starter - key isolation + rotation + emergency revoke are unsolved for multi-tenant. We can support CMKs only if the workload runs on Dedicated or Private and customer keys are strictly scoped. If they absolutely need CMKs immediately, propose Dedicated fallback and provide our exception checklist.
Bea (Finance): At $30k/mo commit our standard discount cap is 6% and net30 terms. Net60 + 10% will need RevOps + CFO approval. Could consider net45 + 7% if we get a 12mo commit and Security approves Dedicated.
SamOps: For provisioning: Dedicated can be provisioned in 48-96h assuming capacity. SLA 99.95 needs reserved capacity => expect ~20% cost uplift. For DocuSign I need final PDFs + signer emails. Also if Legal requires provisional watermark, I can add it but procurement asked not to. Which do we follow?
Lena (Legal): We must protect Redwood: add provisional watermark until Security Exception is complete. I'll prepare a redline reply and a KMS exception addendum template. If procurement objects to watermark, route internally but do not send an unprovisioned final.
Rohit (AE): Nimbus says they can't wait more than 48h to start. Can we offer an interim: Hosted with Redwood-managed keys for initial non-sensitive tests, then migrate to Dedicated for CMK workloads?
Kai (Security): That's acceptable provided the contract restricts CMK use until Dedicated is live and includes migration plan. We'll require an onboarding checklist, audit log forwarding, and a key-revoke runbook before enabling CMKs.
Bea (Finance): If they accept Dedicated after initial tests, I can approve net45 + 7% at $30k/mo, finance OK pending Security sign-off. Net60+10% must escalate.
SamOps: I'll prepare a DocuSign envelope with signer order exactly as requested. I'll add a cover page stating: "Provisionally accepted pending Security Exception - CMKs only on Dedicated/Private." If procurement refuses watermark, we'll loop them to Legal. Need signer emails to proceed.
Lena (Legal): Draft reply summary I'll send: 1) Reject CMKs on Hosted; 2) Offer Dedicated/Private with KMS Addendum + Security Exception; 3) Offer Hosted w/ Redwood keys for initial tests; 4) Pricing conditional on Dedicated provisioning and reserved capacity if they want 99.95 SLA. I'll attach the KMS addendum template.
Rohit (AE): Will relay two-path option to procurement now. Also ask for signer emails and whether they accept a 48-72h provisioning window for Dedicated.
esign-bot: envelope template "poc-orderform-kms-path" created: https://files.redwood.com/envelopes/1717709998 :white_check_mark:
SamOps: FYI capacity file uploaded: https://files.redwood.com/dedicated_capacity_eta.csv. I'll queue provisioning once PO signed and finance confirms terms.
Lena (Legal): One quick legal flag: if their redlines include unilateral audit rights or unlimited liability tied to key compromise, we'll push back. I'll annotate redline PDF and post comments here by EOD.
Rohit (AE): Thanks team. Plan: I will send the two options to Nimbus, attach our redline + KMS addendum, and propose Dedicated start within 48-72h if they prefer CMKs. Will post update in this thread. :thumbsup:
